title: Drainage Ditch Cleaning and Repair
description: Use this service request to report a drainage ditch that needs to be cleaned or repaired. ** If conditions of drainage ditch appears hazardous please Call 3-1-1 for immediate assistance ** Do not use for Inlets/Storm Drains. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 14 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: What type of maintenance is needed?
options: Drainage culvert pipe broken or needs to be replaced

observedQuestions.prompt: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to clean or repair a drainage ditch.
actions.why: Report a nonhazardous drainage ditch needing cleaning, grading, or digging out, or a drainage culvert pipe needing cleaning or replacement. The 311 request form asks what maintenance is needed.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Drainage Ditch Cleaning and Repair" requests does not apply to hazardous ditch conditions or to an inlet or storm drain. If ditch conditions appear hazardous, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Drainage Ditch Cleaning and Repair"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Drainage Ditch Cleaning and Repair"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone for a hazardous drainage ditch.
actions.why: For a drainage ditch condition that appears hazardous. The description for "Drainage Ditch Cleaning and Repair" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs residents to call 311 for immediate assistance.
